title: Read the answers out of a submission's documents

v1.description: Hands a submission whose documents have been parsed to the workflow that reads them, which its schema version names as `readingWorkflow`. Nothing is read here. A system workflow runs straight through with no instance behind it, so it cannot branch, cannot wait and cannot fork; what a reading is worth doing in what order - one call or several, which questions when, what happens to a document that turns out not to be a proposal - is a process, and belongs on a diagram somebody can read and change. A schema version that names no reading workflow simply has none, and this ends without doing anything. Fired only by the reading job, which holds the claim; a submitter asks for another reading through readAgain, which queues that job. An earlier instance of the reading workflow still open on the submission, such as one waiting for a confirmation, is ended first.

read.label: Put the submission through its reading workflow
